item.title: [Lanka Talks] High Grown Tea Production Slumps to an All-Time Low
item.description: Preliminary data from Sri Lanka Tea Board shows September 2026 tea production declined 9% year-on-year to 20.2 Mnkg, with High Grown production hitting lowest since 1992 at 3.49 Mnkg due to excessive rainfall, while cumulative Jan-Sept production fell 3% to 192.6 Mnkg.
